primary_score: equal mean of three rotation scores A = abs(2*F_C(r)-1), where r = log(source_mse+1e-8)-g(log(prefix_motion+1e-8),prefix_missingness)
primary_endpoint: positive-negative-pair-weighted within-outer-fold AUROC difference candidate minus reference
nuisance_ridge_selection: leave-component-out normal-source MSE; scaling refitted within each split; ties favor larger alpha
response: log source MSE + fixed numerical floor inside logarithm

primary_bootstrap.pairing: same sampled components for candidate and reference

limitations: The entire GAVD redevelopment is exploratory after historical outcome exposure.
The nuisance reference uses forecasts trained on fewer sources than the final rotation forecaster.
Calibration and outer sources share the identical final forecast and nuisance model, but this does not prove nuisance removal.
Seven or eight calibration sources produce discrete coarse reference ranks.
Intervals condition on saved fitted models and omit full retraining variability.
Source-relation components cannot resolve unverified repeated participants across uploads.
